purpose: SNAPSHOT BEFORE REVIEW. Commits the exact EXP-SEMBIN-92724f run package (RUN-SEMBIN-cbd770, status completed_valid) and the code that produced it, so TASK-20260913-7ca970's independent review reads committed bytes rather than a working tree. No evidence record, no status change, no promotion travels with this commit.
parent_sha_note: recorded in the archive block of dispatch_queue.json alongside commit_sha
commit_sha_note: A receipt cannot contain the hash of the commit that contains the receipt. The commit binding lives in this task's `archive` block in dispatch_queue.json, which is deliberately NOT one of the declared artifacts, so recording it there is a later commit that does not disturb this one. tools/research_dispatch.py verifies that binding against git.
verification_note: Hashes are sha256 of file content, which is what the dispatcher compares against `git show <commit>:<path>`. Recomputed at archive time from the working tree immediately before the commit that this receipt is part of.
what_is_not_claimed: The snapshot asserts that these exact bytes were committed. It asserts NOTHING about whether the measured coset-typed image ratio supports H-SEMBIN-c59e50, and nothing about any curve's security. The run's own manifest records its arms, its unreached cells if any, and its deviations; those are the reviewer's object, not this receipt's claim. No degree is measured anywhere in the archived artifacts (IMP-SEMBIN-ENGINE bounds arm B/C to coefficient-wise and symbolic comparison).
